description: Dependency update pull requests for k8s-borg, on the shared preset of ioanalytica/renovate-config (schedule, minimum release age, DCO, review requests, the label decision). CONTRIBUTING.md says what the bot updates and what stays manual; tests/renovate-config.bats guards both. The hash pins that go with a version pin are .github/checksums.yaml's: the workflow pin-checksums.yml fills them on the bot's branch.

git-submodules.description: The borg-ui pin moves by hand: each move is a release with its CHANGELOG line.

helm-values.description: The chart's image tags move with the chart's releases.

helmv3.description: The common chart dependency moves with the chart's releases.

customManagers.description: Version pins under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line; a *_DIGEST ARG right below the version is that image's digest.
Tool versions of the workflows and their local actions, an env *_VERSION under a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' line.
The k3s image the page Try it locally creates its k3d cluster with; try-locally.yml runs the page's command. Only releases: no rc tags, no tags of one architecture.
Runner labels of a job matrix (build-image.yml): the github-actions manager reads runners in runs-on only.

packageRules.description: Release tags of the pinned downloads carry a v prefix, the pins do not.
PYTHON_VERSION follows borg-ui's runtime base (tests/python-version.bats) and moves with the borg-ui pin.
The custom manager bumps the MySQL image, version and digest together.
Images the local test stack builds itself.
The runner labels of a matrix go with the runs-on ones; a new major shares their branch by its name.
The preset (renovate.json) and the workflow pin-checksums.yml of ioanalytica/renovate-config move together.
The Renovate that renovate-config.yml runs, once a month: Renovate releases most days.
The k3d of the job try-locally.yml; its pull request runs that job.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/try-locally.bats fails until "Tested with k3d …" in site/guide/try-locally.md names it.

packageRules.description: The k3s of the page Try it locally; its pull request runs the job try-locally.yml.
prBodyNotes: For a new minor, tests/try-locally.bats fails until "Tested with k3d … and k3s …" in site/guide/try-locally.md names it.

packageRules.description: etcd, rclone and s3fs get their CHANGELOG line from the workflow pin-checksums.yml (.github/checksums.yaml).
prBodyNotes: This changes the agent image: add a line under `## Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md before merging.

packageRules.description: The MySQL client stays on the 8.4 LTS series: the newer clients lack the mysql_native_password plugin that MariaDB logins need.
The etcd client is tested against the etcd of k3s and of kubeadm: a new minor is a deliberate move.
s3fs is built from the release with a patch (docker/s3fs/): every release is a deliberate move.
prBodyNotes: The s3fs-builder stage in docker/Dockerfile says when the patch and the stage go. Otherwise check that the patch still applies; the workflow pin-checksums.yml sets `S3FS_SHA512`.

packageRules.description: The documentation site's npm packages (site/), once a month; its pull requests build the site.
The local test stack (local/), once a month.
